svg.title: GeniusLocus Kit Topology — two access paths, three NexusKit call modes
svg.desc: Two top-level paths: MCP tools enter via NexusKit with three call modes (transactional to GeniusLocusKit, algorithm call to NeuronKit, trigger with webhook to CognitionKit). Compiled apps call the library directly. CognitionKit sits above NeuronKit. NeuronKit and NexusKit are peers. GeniusLocusKit composes three substrate kits below.
